newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK SHARES ON LONG-TERM UPTREND ABOVE 1,660PTS-OMEGA.
newsitem.headline: GREEK SHARES ON LONG-TERM UPTREND ABOVE 1,660PTS-OMEGA.

text.p: Technical indicators show Greek shares breaking out of their trading range, but the general index still needs to top 1,660 points to embark on a long-term uptrend, said Omega Securities in a technical analysis report.

"The index continues to oscillate within a slightly upward band since June 23, having built a base around 1,600 points," it said. "But it must clear 1,660 points to validate its move along a long-term rising trend."
Omega said there was a cocktail of reasons supporting the view that current index levels may be the springboard for medium-term growth.
"Friday's close at 1,640 points is critical and very likely to become the starting point of a medium-term uptrend for a large number of reasons," it said, citing the following:

"The RSI topped its previous high without diverging from the index's new short-term zenith, the price oscillator penetrated upwards its 45-day moving average, turnover is picking up, the index's rise is broadly-based and at 1,638 points the index has recovered two thirds of its correction from late May's new all-time high," it said. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
